description: On the tabletop in the corner, there’s a gold book slipcase and several small paperback books nearby. The right hand reaches to the green paperback, grips it as a right-hand object, lifts and rotates it upright, then slides it into the slipcase; it then picks up the red paperback and inserts it next to the green one, and finally takes the blue-gray paperback and pushes it into the remaining space, adjusting the spines flush while the left hand mostly stays resting nearby without touching anything.
